style.styleTitle: Decoris Set of 3 Large Sequin Christmas Baubles
style.toneOfVoice: <p>These classic red baubles are designed to provide maximum sparkle with minimal weight. The lightweight foam core is encased in a layer of shimmering sequins and soft fabric, ensuring that tree branches remain perfectly balanced while reflecting light beautifully. A wide satin bow provides a sophisticated finishing touch, making this set of three a quintessential choice for a vibrant and festive tree.</p><ul><li>8 cm (Diameter)<br></li><li>Red sequins and fabric surface for extra sparkle<br></li><li>Decorative satin bow on top for a festive finish<br></li><li>Comes with hanging ribbon for quick attachment</li></ul>
style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: This Christmas bauble is designed for decorating festive trees with a classic red accent. The foam core keeps the ornament lightweight, so branches remain neat and evenly balanced. A covering of shimmering sequins and soft fabric gives the surface a clearly visible sparkling effect among lights and greenery. The wide satin bow on top adds a neatly finished detail that emphasizes the round shape. On the Christmas tree, the bauble creates a warm, festive look that matches both modern and traditional themes. Made of lightweight foam for easy hanging. Diameter 8 cm for good visibility in the tree. Red sequins and fabric surface for extra sparkle. Decorative satin bow on top for a festive finish. Comes with hanging ribbon for quick attachment.
